Class CollisionsMap

java.lang.Object
utils.CollisionsMap
public class CollisionsMap extends Object
Utility class for handling collision detection between the player and the game map.

This class provides a method to check what type of tile or area the player is colliding with, based on their current position, movement direction, and speed.

    • collisionsMap

      public static String collisionsMap(Playable jeanGuy, ArrayList<Tile> pathTiles, ArrayList<Tile> chunkTiles, int[][] mapTiles, GamePanel gp, Tile[] tiles)
      Determines the type of collision the player (Playable) has with the map.

      The method calculates the bounding box of the player and determines which tiles (from mapTiles and tiles) the player is interacting with. It considers both movement input from the player and damage knockback direction.

      Possible return values:

      • "path": the player is on a walkable path tile.
      • "chunk": the player is on a chunk tile or reached the map boundaries.
      • "merchant": the player is on a merchant tile.
      • "exitmerchant": the player is on an exit tile of the merchant.
      • "block": the player is blocked by a non-walkable tile.
      Parameters:
      jeanGuy - the Playable player whose collision is being checked
      pathTiles - the list of tiles considered as walkable paths
      chunkTiles - the list of tiles considered as map chunks
      mapTiles - a 2D array representing the map, where each element is an index into tiles
      gp - the GamePanel containing screen and tile information
      tiles - an array of Tile objects representing all possible tiles in the game
      Returns:
      a String indicating the type of collision ("path", "chunk", "merchant", "exitmerchant", or "block")
